objective.name: xhand_apple
objective.definition: Sum of squared native digit landing, body contact, mesh penetration, fingertip separation, table/pregrasp clearance and pair-specific joint coordination residuals.
objective.chart: The same pair-specific objective evaluated along the physical replay in the moving object frame; time is simulation time, not solver iterations.
objective.orientation: Fixed downward palm and vertical approach

provenance.execution: Offline MuJoCo free-object contact replay, gravity, bounded native finger actuators, dynamic wrist target. No object attachment or object pose commands after reset. Arm follows with native IK and table-clearance checks.
provenance.grasp_selection: An independent named objective for this hand/object pair, followed by physical lift-and-shake validation. Palm direction is fixed during fitting. Joint coordination and contact regions differ for each pair.
provenance.geometry: The duck is rotated 180 degrees, tail toward the arm. All three ducks use scale 1. The bottle primitives are identical for all three hands; no Shadow-specific reshaping.
provenance.loss: The same pair-specific objective evaluated along the physical replay in the moving object frame; time is simulation time, not solver iterations.
provenance.scope: Illustrative local static-site simulation, pending user visual acceptance; not hardware or benchmark evidence.
